citation.title: Characteristics of toroidal rotation and ion temperature pedestals between ELM bursts in KSTAR H-mode plasmas
citation.authors: S. H. Ko, J. M. Kwon, W. H. Ko, S. S. Kim, H. Jhang, L. Terzolo

topic: Offline analysis of KSTAR CES ion-temperature and toroidal-rotation pedestals between ELMs, including pedestal fitting, parameter correlations and 1D transport analysis.
own_question: How are Ti and rotation pedestals related, and do they indicate residual turbulence and intrinsic torque?
actual_method_and_evidence: The study uses 2014 KSTAR NBI-heated ELMy H-mode shots (six entries in Table I). CES data are sampled every 10 ms with 5 ms averaging. Time slices overlapping ELM crashes were excluded. Pedestals were fit with modified tanh functions. Correlations reported: rotation pedestal versus Ti_ped, Ti_ped/Ip and gradient, and DTi<DV across the cases. A 1D transport analysis of two time slices used NUBEAM sources and Thomson density. The paper presents no prediction, nowcasting, BES or ECEI work.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: KSTAR CES routinely provides pedestal Ti and rotation profiles. Ko et al. report about 10 ms sampling with 5 ms averaging and about 0.5 cm edge resolution, from 2014 campaign data.
claim_checks.qualification: These are the source's 2014 specifications, not the 2022 campaign. The source does not report report-arrival latency. It does not specify whether its Ti is impurity Ti or main-ion Ti; do not infer carbon.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Edge Ti and rotation pedestals in KSTAR evolve between ELMs, and ELM-overlapping CES windows were excluded from the analysis.
claim_checks.qualification: This is offline profile analysis of selected long-ELM-period shots. It does not show that Ti is predictable from fluctuation diagnostics.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: CES 10 ms frames with 5 ms averaging; Thomson 10 ms. Arrival times are unknown.
validation_if_relevant: None. The study is offline correlation plus a transport inference on two slices.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite it as evidence of intrinsic torque proven or of a physical mechanism; the authors call their residual-stress fit suggestive.
Do not cite it as support that BES/ECEI can predict CES temperature.
Do not imply real-time or causal estimation.
Do not apply its 2014 resolution figures to the 2022 chord.
Do not cite it as independent ground truth for CES labels.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Include it as a KSTAR-specific background citation for CES pedestal Ti measurement cadence and inter-ELM pedestal evolution. Its residual-turbulence interpretation can support the theory section as the authors' interpretation, not as an established result.
